- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:43-102 | severity=major | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: extract_disposition classifies the entire audit bullet instead of only the disposition token, allowing reason-tail keywords and unhandled negated forms such as “not fixed” or “not addressed” to produce the wrong disposition.
  WHY: Rejected entries can be classified as “already satisfied” or “applied”, while applied entries can be classified as “ignored”, causing incorrect resolution and missing or spurious rationale replies.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3939-4143 | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The “Resolve addressed PR review threads” step runs before “Detect editor-claimed-but-uncommitted changes” and does not gate applied resolutions on persisted changes.
  WHY: Severity disagreement (BLOCKER versus MAJOR/NIT): a falsely applied audit can resolve a thread before did_commit/EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST is checked, and later iterations skip the already-resolved thread.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads.sh:251-291 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: An ignored-entry rationale reply is posted before the resolve mutation, so a failed mutation leaves the thread open with a reply that will be posted again on the next iteration.
  WHY: Transient resolve failures can accumulate duplicate rationale replies in the review thread.
- scripts/review_resolve_review_threads_plan.py:188-192 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A transient resolve mutation failure can leave an open thread re-proposed on the next autofix iteration.
  WHY: Repeated transient API failures can cause repeated resolve attempts and potentially loop indefinitely.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
